title: Public health versus vendors' livelihoods
news: UP has banned industrial dyes in street food after finding them in chutneys; many small vendors use them unknowingly.
syllabus: Public service values · Ethical dilemmas in government
link: A food safety officer must protect public health while being fair to poor vendors who act out of ignorance, not malice.
question: As a food safety officer, you find many poor street vendors using a banned dye unknowingly. Strict action will hit their livelihoods. What will you do?

title: Cyclone Arnab: the most vulnerable first
news: Andhra Pradesh moved 4,711 pregnant women to hospitals before the cyclone; Odisha sent ministers to the districts.
syllabus: Compassion towards the weaker sections · Accountability and ethical governance
link: The care ethics of the state, and a best practice in disaster management: plan for those who cannot protect themselves.
question: 'The ethics of care is the first principle of disaster management.' Discuss with an example.
